identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Study of Anti-CD22:TCRz:4-1BB T-cells in Patient With CD22-Positive Recurrent Lymphoma That is Resistant or Refractory to Prior Anti-CD22:TCRz:CD28 Immunotherapy

descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Primary Objectives

1. To determine the safety of CD22.CAR-T cells in lymphoma patients refractory or resistent to anti-CD19:TCRz:CD28 CAR-T cells
2. To determine in vivo dynamics and persistency of CD22.CAR-T cells.

Secondary Objectives

1. To determine the feasibility of CD22.CAR-T cells in lymphoma patients refractory or resistent to anti-CD19:TCRz:CD28 CAR-T cells
2. To determine in vivo dynamics and persistency of CD22.CAR-T cells.
3. To assess the intratumoral infiltration of CD22.CAR-T cells.
4. To correlate the subsets and differentiation of CD22.CAR-T cells to observed anti-tumor efficacy

conditions: Recurrent Adult Diffuse Large Cell Lymphoma
Stage III/IV Adult Diffuse Large Cell Lymphoma

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety measured by occurrence of study related adverse effects defined by NCI CTCAE 4.0

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall complete remission rate defined by the standard response criteria for malignant lymphoma for each arm
Duration of CAR-positive T cells in circulation
Total number of CAR-positive T cells infiltrated into lymphoma tissue
